prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Your Desktop Pet Companion", "Your companion is now live on your screen. Use your taskbar tray icon to access controls, switch pets, or toggle visibility anytime."]
1: ["Taskbar Tray Quick Controls", "Right-click the desktop pet icon in your system tray to quickly adjust settings, minimize, or bring your pet back to focus.", "Got It, Start Using Pet"]
2: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Path"]
3: ["Choose Your Starting Desktop Pet"]
4: ["Signing in connects your pet to your account, ensuring your companion and preferences are never lost."]
5: ["Configuring companion desktop rendering assets. Please leave the app open while we finish setup."]
6: ["Upload a Well-Lit Photo of Your Pet", "For the best custom generation, use a clear, front-facing photo with solid lighting and a clean background."]
7: ["Welcome to Your New Desktop Companion", "Your pet lives on your desktop and system tray, providing friendly companionship and quick controls while you work."]
8: ["Your adoption details and companion data are securely tied to your profile."]
9: ["Can't see your pet? Click the taskbar tray icon anytime to toggle desktop visibility."]
